production_bridge.present: The runtime restores, authenticates, checkpoints and advances a coordinator through host-supplied owners. Config/runtime plumbing can spawn it when explicitly supplied together with the governed plasticity owner.
production_bridge.exact_gap: The complete codex-rs search finds only the test IterationPorts implementation of LearningIterationOwnerPortsV1, in hepta-agentd/src/learning_iteration_runtime_tests.rs:98. The checkpoint owner itself explicitly states that it does not implement the missing complete production adapter. The default bootstrap is None.
production_bridge.consequence: No demonstrated production caller connects actual training job, independent evaluation, signed owner receipt, current selection and committed next-use under one stable operation. Payment, paid cold retrieval and installation are not stages of this coordinator.

negative_search_evidence.scope: codex-rs; implementation and explicit bootstrap callers

synthetic_receipt_construction.meaning: decision builds digest-labelled experience/dataset/training/evaluation receipts directly. Training reports steps=1, milliseconds=1, artifact_bytes=64; evaluation is NoUpdate. observed assigns the expected actor and evidence_digest from the literal fixture-role-attestation label. This is coordinator fixture construction, not an independently authenticated training/evaluation result.

The adopted fixture reuses the earlier experience and dataset receipts, creates a labelled candidate, then records literal training steps=1/milliseconds=1/artifact_bytes=64, Qualified evaluation and UpdateCandidates proposal.

All five use a test control with OUTPUT=b"synthetic successor task"; it copies request.input into successor state, emits the literal output, increments execution/read counters and reads back the same request result. Native publication, journal, actor and outbox paths are real; learning evidence and model execution are synthetic.

stages.name: 真实训练
stages.effect: The reference Adapter.train primitive updates model parameters, optimizer moments, step, RNG and sampler state. The runtime can request a Training stage under a separate quota and checkpoint an authenticated receipt.
stages.unconnected: No production LearningIterationOwnerPortsV1 implementation calls this trainer or reconciles its durable remote job and authenticates the resulting exact closure. The selected controls never call Adapter.train; their step/time/byte fields are literal fixtures.

stages.name: 独立评价
stages.effect: Evaluation checks candidate and fixed-expert journals against the frozen plan before the existing product temporal-comparison runner uses final holdout state; qualification requires authenticated evidence and a durable publication sink.
stages.unconnected: The available evaluation runner is not joined to the learning iteration by a production ports adapter. The selected readback cases directly construct Qualified/NoUpdate observations and do not establish trainer/evaluator organizational or failure-domain independence.

stages.name: 选择
stages.effect: Verifies current trust/eligibility/withdrawal state and an Ed25519 selector signature; selector and producer differ. Loads the exact pinned payload, decodes CellBackendManifestV2 and binds its full digest. Revalidation checks current selection and withdrawal again before guarded use.
stages.unconnected: The candidate's actual training/evaluation lineage is synthetic in these cases. Loading a selected backend manifest does not prove that every model/runtime asset was loaded, and local selector distinctness does not prove an independent deployed evaluator.

stages.name: 支付
stages.effect: The generic durable store admits a bounded effect under current authority; generation publication changes the Control CURRENT writer through a guarded CAS. These are existing reusable effect boundaries.
stages.unconnected: The learning stage enum has no payment stage. The traced owner path has no Chain settlement caller or same-iteration paid receipt. CURRENT publication is a local generation-writer effect, not payment. Generic durable-store tests use local test effects and cannot establish Chain payment or a paid model purchase.

stages.name: 冷取
stages.effect: Cold generation helpers reopen supplied predecessor journals and guarded current state; pinned candidate reads a supplied already-opened file. V13 acceptance descriptors open local interpreter/model asset files into capabilities.
stages.unconnected: Local journal reopen is not remote paid content retrieval. No selected test obtains the trained/evaluated/paid closure from independent custodians or over qualified WAN failure domains. An authenticated retrieval client, storage-lease/payment binding and exact downloaded closure handoff are not connected by this learning owner.

stages.name: 安装
stages.effect: The explicit administrator API copies agentd and optional matrixd executables into an immutable staged release, records hashes/sizes, fsyncs and renames it, then uses per-agent release allowances.
stages.unconnected: This installs executable releases, not a model closure. Complete install_release_bundle token search finds API/self-delegation and tests; the selected twelve controls do not invoke it. No production learning-loop caller connects payment/cold-fetched closure, installation allowance and the exact V13 model files.

stages.name: 加载
stages.effect: The explicit V13 path pins the complete resumable closure and exactly 24 allowed assets plus interpreter/script hashes. A retained executable FD starts bounded Verify and Infer processes. Python verifies the complete checkpoint closure, reloads exact model bytes, checks state/encoder/source/data pins, runs ONNX encoding and model inference, and refuses changed inference state.
stages.unconnected: The selected controls substitute Control::execute_generation and never run this loader. Typed bootstrap/example callers do exist; they are not a production LearningIterationOwnerPortsV1 bridge, are not the default ordinary CLI selection, and were not executed in this campaign. OS process executable and actual model-load identity remain NOT_OBSERVED.

stages.name: 下一任务
stages.effect: Runtime readback derives the committed original intent receipt, current checkpoint, selection and cutover/retained publication from the running generation owner. It does not accept a caller-supplied receipt, grant or success flag. The typed V13 runtime can spawn the real controlled worker.
stages.unconnected: The real journal commit/readback exercised here contains synthetic successor output, not a task run by the model produced by this iteration. The production ports adapter still has to obtain this readback and independently attest NextUse under the same original operation; no payment/cold-fetch/install sequence precedes it in this run.

stages.name: UNKNOWN恢复与重启
stages.effect: Training timeout returns CommitUncertain. Generation recovery reopens and reads the original operation; pending publication does not redispatch. The durable store records dispatch admission before effect, retains indeterminate work, and accepts a matching terminal observer result without inventing another operation. Restart retains the original pending work and exact committed outbox.
stages.unconnected: The tests establish local operation/actor semantics with test authorities and destinations. They do not reconcile a real remote training job or a real Chain payment after unknown acknowledgement. D4 uses child process exit boundaries; it does not qualify power-loss, arbitrary SIGKILL, disk faults or WAN behavior.

stages.name: 撤销与最终效果权限
stages.effect: Before current use, rechecks selection/withdrawal and retained final-use grant against the current independent authority frontier, exact epoch/revocation revision and consumed nonce; CURRENT is rechecked after authority IO. Published recovery keeps the original grant and operation.
stages.unconnected: The inspected final-use and selection signatures are Ed25519. These controls do not exercise a deployed PQ profile or downgrade rejection, and do not join Chain authority to every model-load/external-effect edge. Current classical owner refusal is useful evidence but does not qualify whole-PQ final use.

stages.name: 重组
stages.effect: Current owner, independent authority frontier and durable-operation recovery are present. They provide local fencing/recovery primitives.
stages.unconnected: The complete reorg/reorganiz search across agentd, learning-artifacts, fleet and operations source returns no hits. The traced loop has no demonstrated canonical Chain reorg callback that updates payment/availability/authority while preserving the original effect identity. A local CURRENT or rollback frontier is not Chain canonicality. Chain #787 controls must be run on the final frozen Chain candidate and cannot be borrowed as this f178 pair's result.

no_update_vs_unknown.no_update: NoUpdate is an explicit completed evaluation disposition. It retains the evaluated baseline, still requires a current selection and committed use by a distinct task, preserves the same manifest, and derives the retained task operation from the original learning operation and decision head. It does not authorize installing the rejected candidate.
no_update_vs_unknown.unknown: Timeout or ambiguous stage/commit remains CommitUncertain and requires reconciliation of the original stable job. It is not an evaluation disposition and cannot be relabelled NoUpdate.
no_update_vs_unknown.observed_control: L1 rejects use of a NoUpdate coordinator as an adopted update; L3/L4 exercise retained baseline publication/readback with a synthetic completed NoUpdate decision. U1-U3 and D1-D4 cover local uncertain execution/restart. No selected test establishes that a real remote training timeout is reconciled end to end.

model_load_ownership.host_owner: Explicit host opens and supplies interpreter, worker and asset file capabilities; configuration supplies exact closure/runtime/device pins.
model_load_ownership.agentd_owner: prepare_agentd_v13_generation_worker_v1 and V13BackendOwner bind the worker to original durable inference control, scope, manifest, writer epoch and limits. ReadyAgentdV13GenerationUpdateV1::into_runtime spawns that controlled worker.
model_load_ownership.rust_worker_owner: V13GenerationProcessWorkerV1 validates resumable closure and complete asset set; cell_v13_process::run rehashes the retained executable and starts Verify/Infer using the original FD.
model_load_ownership.python_load_owner: proposal_worker.verify authenticates closure bytes. proposal_worker.infer performs Adapter.load and FrozenEncoder/ONNX execution and checks no learning-state mutation.
model_load_ownership.limits: These are explicit acceptance/typed paths. Their presence is source evidence; this native control campaign used a synthetic worker and supplies no observed loader identity or trained-model task output.

Durable training job -> full resumable model closure and authentic original-owner receipt.
Frozen independent evaluator -> signed current evaluation decision -> production learning coordinator.
Learning decision -> Chain service/payment settlement -> paid immutable content identity.
Paid content -> independent-custodian cold retrieval/WAN-qualified bytes -> host file capabilities.
Retrieved model closure -> installation/current selection allowance -> actual bound V13 process.
Actual model task commit -> independent NextUse attestation/checkpoint for the same iteration.
Remote UNKNOWN/restart/reorg -> original job/payment/effect reconciliation without duplicate execution.
Chain PQ final-use profile -> every real load/effect boundary with current revocation and downgrade refusal.
